politeAccess: HTTPS only, no credentials; at most one request start per 1.1 s per host (serial per-host queue), bounded envelopes and counts; outFields limited to native-ID, object-ID and ID-part fields.

identity.choice: PlatLot is the only parcel reference; its 2-letter prefix equals TownCode on every row, so it is statewide-distinct. In Providence 43 of 45 repeated values are exact duplicate rows and one (PR 004-0150-0000) is two touching parts; bare town-code placeholders (e.g. PR, 5 distinct polygons) are excluded.

prefixCheck: SUBSTRING(PlatLot FROM 1 FOR 2) <> TownCode matched 0 rows statewide; every prefix is one of the 39 town codes.
coverageCaveats: PlatLot formatting differs by town (e.g. "PR 002-0015-0000", "BI 1:11", "NP3-32"); the two-letter town code prefix keeps references distinct across towns.

Bare town-code placeholders and incomplete dash-terminated references that repeat across rows (61 values plus empty/space, 1,313 rows statewide on 2026-10-12) are excluded; single-row incomplete references remain as published.
Many plat/lots are published as exact duplicate rows with identical geometry (43 of 45 repeated values in Providence); some as touching parts, which are dissolved by polygon union.
A newly published repeated placeholder would be merged as one parcel when disjoint; the exclusion list reflects the 2026-10-12 publication.
Environmental-analysis layer (watershed and aquifer attributes); assessment geometry, not a boundary survey.
